faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: What people ask before getting started.
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a1: Not at all. Everything is configured with clicks. If you can use WhatsApp, you can use Parallly. Onboarding walks you through in under 10 minutes.
faq.a2: You upload your information (catalog, FAQs, rules) and pick your industry. The AI learns and replies in your tone. We use advanced models (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini) trained on your business info.
faq.q3: Is it secure? What about my data?
faq.a3: 100% secure. Military-grade encryption (AES-256-GCM), data isolated per company (each tenant has its own database schema), daily backups. Payments processed by MercadoPago — we never touch your CVV. GDPR-compliant.
faq.q4: What if the AI messes up?
faq.a4: No worries. If the AI doesn't know what to say or detects a phrase like 'I want to talk to a human', it hands off to your team instantly with full context. Your team doesn't start from scratch.
faq.a5: 1 hour to have your AI agent answering with real info. Seriously: connect WhatsApp via official Meta OAuth, pick your industry, upload basic info and you're done.
faq.q6: Does it work in my country?
faq.a6: Yes. Full LatAm phone number support (CO, AR, MX, BR, CL, PE, EC, UY) plus US/Canada. Local currency pricing where applicable (COP, ARS, MXN, CLP, PEN, UYU, BRL, USD).
faq.q7: Can I change plans, pause or cancel?
faq.a7: Anytime. Pause when you go on vacation, cancel at the end of the period (you keep access until then), or cancel immediately. All from a panel — no support calls.
faq.q8: Does it integrate with my current system?
faq.a8: Yes. Open API + webhooks to integrate with your existing ERP/CRM. Parallly brings its own complete CRM, but you can also connect to HubSpot, Salesforce or others.
